label: Group law on abelian schemes
gloss: Lemmas about group-scheme laws, pullbacks and line bundles on abelian schemes, plus some algebra on powers and torsion.

label: Adelic lattices and algebraic number theory
gloss: A mix of small lemmas on adelic lattices, ideals, indices of subgroups and matrix groups, with one Dedekind zeta result.

label: Characters of finite general linear groups
gloss: Character theory of finite groups, mainly GL_n over finite fields, with supporting polynomial and module algebra.

label: Coherent cohomology of line bundles
gloss: Lemmas on Cech complexes, perfect complexes and graded modules used to compute cohomology of line bundles.

label: Cubical line bundles and CM abelian varieties
gloss: Facts about line bundles and group schemes over abelian varieties, including CM cases and Hermitian forms.

label: Families of abelian schemes and cusp forms
gloss: A mix of lemmas on holomorphic families of abelian schemes, formal group charts and determinant or counting bounds.

label: Theta lifts and Weil representation
gloss: Lemmas on theta series, the Weil representation, Haar measures and lattices for unitary groups, with some adelic integrality facts.

label: Degeneration of abelian schemes
gloss: Lemmas on group schemes, line bundles and sections over valuation rings, used to study degeneration of abelian varieties.

label: Abelian schemes and theta lifts
gloss: A very large mix of abelian scheme geometry, theta correspondence and unitary group lemmas, with some p-adic Hodge theory.

label: Hermitian lattices and flag measures
gloss: Lemmas on Hermitian lattices, unitary groups, orbit counting and Haar measure over flags, tied to the Siegel-Weil formula.

label: Formal group charts and power series
gloss: Small lemmas on formal groups, power series substitution and ideals, mixed with some line bundle pullbacks.

label: Modular forms and Galois congruences
gloss: A mix of modular form facts (Hecke operators, congruences, Galois conjugates) and basic number field and valuation lemmas.

label: Frames and cusp form nonvanishing
gloss: A small mix of lemmas on frame norms, flag charts and matrix rank, aimed at showing a cusp form is nonzero.

label: Adelic orbits and polynomial bounds
gloss: A mix of lemmas on adelic orbits, self-dual lattices, polynomial weights and perturbation bounds.

label: Lattice and representation lemmas
gloss: A scattered set of lemmas on K-types, Casimir actions, short lattice vectors and Hermitian size bounds.

label: p-adic Hodge theory and Galois cohomology
gloss: Mostly p-adic period rings and Galois cohomology bounds, mixed with local number field algebra and unitary group measure lemmas.

label: Hermitian lattices and number field algebra
gloss: A broad mix of lattice, adelic, CM field, moduli chart and representation lemmas with no single theme.

label: Theta integrals and lattice algebra
gloss: A mix of algebra on ideals and power series, Fourier and theta integral estimates, and Hermitian lattice facts.

label: Theta structures on abelian schemes
gloss: Lemmas on line bundles, theta structures and group objects over schemes, building the moduli of polarised abelian schemes.

label: Level structures and sections over DVRs
gloss: Lemmas on sections, charts and level structures of abelian varieties over discrete valuation rings and CM fields.

label: Hecke characters and local Galois data
gloss: A mix of unramified Hecke characters, local Langlands facts, Frobenius eigenvalues and lattice linear algebra.

label: Hermitian lattices over CM fields
gloss: A mix of Hermitian lattice integrality over CM fields and theta series identities.

label: Theta functions on abelian schemes
gloss: Lemmas on theta constants, polarised abelian schemes over local rings and ampleness of line bundle products.

label: CM points and theta shifts
gloss: Lemmas on line bundle generators, CM fibres and arc points over schemes, ending in a theta shift identity.

label: Lattice heights and Haar integrability
gloss: A small mix of analytic inequalities and lattice height lemmas, with integrability of Haar measures.

label: Theta correspondence and cusp forms
gloss: Lemmas on theta functions, the Heisenberg and Fock models, cusp forms and smooth representations of unitary groups.

label: Line bundles on abelian schemes
gloss: Lemmas on line bundle sections, gluing of morphisms and endomorphisms of thickened schemes.

label: CM moduli and Hermitian lattices
gloss: A mix of CM field arithmetic, lattice stabilisers, moduli over DVRs and theta function transformations.

label: Power series and formal group algebra
gloss: Lemmas on multivariate power series, truncation and valuation bounds, plus Witt vector and l-adic convergence facts.

label: Commutative algebra toolkit
gloss: General commutative algebra lemmas on local rings, ideals, resultants and polynomial interpolation.

label: Cusp forms and automorphic representations
gloss: Lemmas on cusp forms, Whittaker supports, conjugation and base change for automorphic representations.

label: Galois characters and l-adic units
gloss: A mix of facts on l-adic units, Galois characters on inertia, and chain complex face maps.

label: Cuspidal representations and conjugation
gloss: Lemmas on conjugating cuspidal representations, smooth function pullbacks and bounds on adelic GL.

label: Galois groups and matrix characters
gloss: Lemmas on local rings, Galois fixed fields, characters of triangular matrices and Galois cohomology ranks.

label: Bernoulli numbers and Galois cohomology
gloss: Facts on Bernoulli numbers, Gauss sums and L-values of Dirichlet characters, with Galois cohomology length bounds.

label: Invariant forms and cohomology of groups
gloss: A mix of representation theory of matrix groups, cusp form results and cochain complexes.

label: Automorphy lifting and Galois representations
gloss: A mix of Galois representation deformation rings, Hecke operators and trace formula steps toward automorphy of a rank four form.

label: Galois deformations and cocycles
gloss: A mix of lemmas on deformations of Galois representations, cocycle ranks and p-adic characters.

label: Complete local rings and lattices
gloss: Commutative algebra on complete local rings and DVRs, with some representation lemmas used in patching.

label: Matrix traces and Galois cocycles
gloss: A mix of small lemmas on traces and representations, valuation characters, Galois cocycles and index counting.

label: Galois representation lifting and algebra
gloss: A mix of ring and matrix algebra, lifting of Galois representations and cocycle lemmas.

label: Convolution operators on adelic groups
gloss: Lemmas on convolution operators, local Hecke operators and adelic embeddings for GL_n.

label: Siegel-Weil, Galois and cohomology lemmas
gloss: A mix of lemmas on Siegel-Weil, CM field arithmetic, Galois representations and etale cohomology.

label: Indefinite theta lifts and Howe duality
gloss: Lemmas on theta lifts for indefinite Hermitian lattices, Howe duality, genus masses and local characters.

label: Heights and lattices over valuation rings
gloss: A mix of commutative algebra over DVRs, lattice heights and projective variety counts.

label: Representations and homological algebra
gloss: A large mix of representation theory of GL_n, homological algebra, Siegel-Weil analysis and local field lemmas.

label: Heights on CM moduli towers
gloss: A mix of valuation bounds, successive minima and arithmetic intersection numbers on CM moduli.

label: CM moduli and arithmetic geometry
gloss: Lemmas on CM moduli, toroidal compactifications, charts and heights of line bundles, plus some commutative algebra.

label: Adelic analysis and zeta integrals
gloss: A mix of lemmas on adelic integrals, Shintani zeta values, Euler products and lattice sums.

label: Matrix identities and heights
gloss: A mix of block matrix algebra, Hermitian forms, polynomial bounds and height inequalities for line bundles.

label: Siegel-Weil formula hypotheses
gloss: Statements and test-function setup for the Siegel-Weil formula, with local and adelic measures and Whittaker functions.

label: Valuation rings and group scheme torsors
gloss: Algebra on valuation rings, power series and torsion of group schemes, with some Hodge compactification statements.

label: Crystalline and semistable comparison
gloss: Statements of p-adic comparison theorems between crystalline, semistable, de Rham and etale cohomology.

label: Poitou-Tate and Casselman-Wallach theorems
gloss: A mix of published theorems stated as hypotheses, from Galois cohomology, representation theory and homological algebra.

label: Graded polynomial algebra and moduli frames
gloss: A mix of polynomial and module algebra, frames on moduli and torsion points of tori.

label: Hermitian Gram matrices over CM fields
gloss: Lemmas on Hermitian Gram matrices and unitary group orbit measures, with some Hida setting and A_inf variants.

label: Stabiliser volumes and self-dual measures
gloss: Haar measure uniqueness and stabiliser volume hypotheses in the unitary group mass formula.

label: Arithmetic Bezout and Hermitian norms
gloss: A mix of polynomial and prime ideal algebra, Hermitian norm and area estimates used for an arithmetic Bezout theorem.

label: Analytic sets and ideal heights
gloss: Commutative algebra of primes and completions, plus analytic set parametrisation and Hausdorff measure under linear maps.

label: Multihomogeneous polynomials and flag degrees
gloss: Lemmas on multihomogeneous ideals, flag degrees and multiplicities used in arithmetic height computations.

label: Euler characteristics and chart gluing
gloss: A mix of small lemmas on twists of subsystems, Euler characteristics, localisation covers and Hermitian inverses.

label: Hermitian lattice covolumes
gloss: Covolume formulas and continuity for Hermitian lattices, with Haar coordinates on unitary groups.

label: Lattice covolumes and height algebra
gloss: A mix of positive definite matrix lemmas, lattice covolumes and polynomial substitutions for heights.

label: Hilbert-Samuel counting and arithmetic volumes
gloss: Multigraded Hilbert polynomial counting and arithmetic volume bounds for line bundles on projective varieties.

label: Hodge flag heights and lower bounds
gloss: Lower bounds for heights of Hodge flags, using Plucker coordinates, Hermitian metrics and flag integrals.

label: Heights of multihomogeneous polynomials
gloss: Algebra of multihomogeneous polynomials, local rings and dimension, used to bound heights of intersections.

label: Kleiman ampleness criterion
gloss: Lemmas for Kleiman's ampleness criterion: Snapper polynomials, Cech vanishing and very ample twists.

label: Height counting and Lelong limits
gloss: A mix of lattice point counts, Lelong-type limits of zero-set integrals and height bounds on projective varieties.

label: Alternating polynomials and Young diagrams
gloss: Algebra of alternating polynomials and Vandermonde determinants, with partition and Young diagram counting.
